algorithm_contract.idf_warning: The pinned Signac method computes IDF from peak row sums, not an independently substituted document-frequency formula. With nonbinary peak counts these quantities differ.
algorithm_contract.warning: The registry prespecifies exclusion of the first depth-associated component. That exclusion, the component indexing, the retained dimension, and the SVD sign-orientation fixture must be frozen before activation and cannot be changed after inspecting held outcomes.

embedding_contract.held_query_transform: Apply the training-frozen peak order, training IDF vector, method-1 normalization, and the exact fitted TruncatedSVD.transform without refitting.
embedding_contract.sign_indeterminacy: Retain and hash the exact fitted SVD object or canonicalize component signs using a training-only deterministic rule. Never refit to recover signs on held rows.
embedding_contract.warning: A query transform requires observed ATAC counts on the frozen peak universe. LSI is not an RNA-to-ATAC predictor.

implementation.warning: Signac is the formula authority, not an additional runtime dependency. A project implementation must reproduce a fixed sparse-matrix fixture against the pinned Signac source before admission.

input_contract.feature_alignment: exact ordered outer-training peak inventory represented as GRCh38.p14 coordinate tuples plus stable project row IDs
input_contract.peak_policy: Call, merge, filter, and order peaks using outer-training donors only. Held rows are projected to the frozen inventory without allowing their counts to change feature selection or IDF.
input_contract.query_zero_semantics: Zero means an assayed frozen peak with no observed count. A structurally unavailable assay, failed reference crosswalk, absent donor-state, or permission block remains explicit missingness and is not inserted as a zero row.

leakage_contract.held_query_policy: Only deterministic matrix projection and TruncatedSVD.transform are permitted. No held-row IDF recomputation, SVD refit, component selection, peak filtering, head tuning, or calibration.
leakage_contract.study_policy: Use study-level outer folds where feasible and donor-grouped folds otherwise. Every modality from one person remains in one outer fold.

runtime_contract.resource_note: Memory is driven by cells times retained peaks and sparse intermediate copies; record peak count, nonzeros, peak memory, BLAS/thread settings, wall time, and artifact sizes.

safe_loading_contract.package_acquisition: If later approved, verify the exact CPython 3.11 x86_64 manylinux wheel SHA-256 before installation in an isolated environment.
safe_loading_contract.warning: Do not accept external pickle or joblib artifacts. If a project-owned object format is used, restore only from an immutable campaign path and validate dimensions, finite values, feature IDs, and hashes.

source_evidence: The exact Signac RunTFIDF implementation, official Signac documentation, scikit-learn 1.9.0 source revision and TruncatedSVD documentation, and PyPI release attestation were checked on 2026-08-22. No package was installed and no model was fit.

task_fit.development_only_candidate: Inductive observed-ATAC cell representation and donor-compatible integration after a separate nonpromotable TaskSpec freezes rows, peaks, components, labels, baselines, metrics, and no-champion scope.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: ineligible because the held transform consumes the observed target ATAC matrix rather than producing a profile from RNA/context
task_fit.sealed_cell_state_mapping: ineligible because GSE289173 exposes RNA-only nuclei
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: ineligible because LSI has no nucleotide sequence, REF/ALT, or signed regulatory-effect mechanism
